neighbors.establishing_passage: The study linked Mirai features to mammographic observations and reported that a decoder restricted to calcification features retained five-year risk performance; it discussed benign calcification but did not isolate BAC.
Introduced Mirai as an image-only mammographic breast-cancer risk model and evaluated it across institutions.
Developed automated BAC detection and quantification and correlated predictions with measured BAC length.
AI ILA scores rose across reader-rated traction bronchiectasis severity categories, providing association but not isolated model-use evidence.
Defined airway tapering as an objective CT biomarker for bronchiectasis.
A deep model classified fibrotic lung disease on HRCT with performance comparable to thoracic radiologists.
RoentMod created realistic pathology counterfactual CXRs and used them to expose off-target shortcut responses in multitask and foundation models.
TorchXRayVision released standardized CXR datasets and pretrained pathology classifiers including consolidation outputs.
Automated and standardized quantitative analysis of cardiovascular borders on chest radiographs.
S(H)NAP removed and inserted pulmonary nodules to audit Sybil, reporting nodule contributions, interactions, artifacts, and radial bias; a full-text search found no calcification experiment.
Sybil predicted one- to six-year lung-cancer risk from a single LDCT and included exploratory analyses involving visible future-cancer nodules.
A hierarchical semantic CNN jointly predicted nodule malignancy and human semantic attributes including calcification.
Developed weakly supervised subcutaneous-edema segmentation on abdominal CT.
Quantitative lung HU measurements distinguished pulmonary edema severity on routine chest CT.
Trained CT models to detect, segment, and characterize pleural effusions directly.
